scene.bubble: Special report: our town, 50 years ago and today! Grandpa says the main square was much quieter… and had more pigeons.

activities.title: Listen to Grandpa's memories. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (entrevistando) y el Abuelo (voz mayor, cálida).
data.script: Diego: Grandpa, what was the town like fifty years ago? … Grandpa: Much smaller, Diego! The main street was narrow, with stone houses. … Grandpa: There were only two cars in the whole town. Two! … Diego: And the square? … Grandpa: More peaceful than today. We played football there every evening. … Grandpa: The market was the heart of everything. My mother sold cheese there. … Diego: Is anything better now? … Grandpa: Oh yes! The hospital is much better. And the library is bigger. … Grandpa: But the ice cream… the ice cream was definitely better before!
